description.value: John's Pan Pizza is a local Richmond pizzeria specializing in pan-style pizza made fresh daily, with dine-in, pickup, and delivery options. The menu spans classic and loaded pizzas, appetizers, flatbreads, sides, and milkshakes. Cyclists will appreciate the inclusive menu that includes gluten-free and vegan pizza options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 9m; loops (12 spaces) at 21m; rack at 34m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms the business is active, listing phone numbers, services (pickup and delivery), and menu items including vegan and gluten-free pizza. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. There is a unit number discrepancy: OSM tags list unit 120, while the website lists unit 130 — flagged in concerns.
concerns: Unit number discrepancy: OSM tags list addr:unit=120, but the website shows unit 130 (130-12420 No. 1 Road). Physical unit should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant with a live website, confirmed phone numbers, and publicly accessible dine-in and pickup services.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'We do offer Gluten-free and Vegan pizza as well.'

wow_evidence: local Richmond pizzeria specializing in pan-style pizza made fresh daily
